      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:

          type: string

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80

          title: Telephone number

            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is converted to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,

            is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. So

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is converted to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise the country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0'
            is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. So
            '0412 345 678' is stored and returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

        - type: object
          properties:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

              description: >-

The change is complete. Summary of what I implemented:

**Rule:** Creating an owner is now rejected with **409 Conflict** when another owner already has the same `lastName` **and** the same `address` — compared case-insensitively after trimming and collapsing internal whitespace runs to a single space — **unless** the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

**Changes (standard Spring/OpenAPI-first idioms):**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a write-only boolean `sharesHousehold` property to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` exposes the flag (Jackson was already ignoring it as an unknown field, silently dropping the opt-in).

2. **`rest/advice/DuplicateOwnerException.java`** (new) — a `RuntimeException` mirroring the existing `DuplicateTelephoneException` pattern.

3. **`rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`** — a new `@ExceptionHandler` mapping `DuplicateOwnerException` to a `409` `ProblemDetail`, reporting `lastName` and `address` in the `errors` array.

4. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — added `requireUniqueHousehold(...)` (invoked from the existing `normalizeAndValidate` create path) plus a `collapseWhitespace` helper. It short-circuits when `sharesHousehold` is true, otherwise scans existing owners and throws when a case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed `lastName`+`address` match is found.

5. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — ignored the write-only `sharesHousehold` on the `Owner → OwnerDto` response mapping.

All three acceptance tests (`coreRejectsSameLastNameAndAddress`, `functionalityAllowsDifferentAddress`, `functionalityAllowsWithSharesHousehold`) and the full `mvn test` build are green.
